Title: Enermax - REVOLUTION D.F. X - 80 PLUS Gold Netzteil
URL: https://www.enermaxeu.com/products/power-supplies/high-end/revolution-d-f-x/index.html
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
REVOLUTION D.F. X rounds off the REVOLUTIONs series and is primarily aimed at gamers and content creators. In addition to a native 12VHPWR cable for the obligatory Intel ATX 3.0 and PCIe 5.0 standard it offers another dual 8pin to 12VHPWR cable. This cable can support an additional graphic card or for future OC graphic cards, which require two 12VHPWR connectors. The connectors have the “4-spring design”, which is recommended by Intel®. 

Like the REVOLUTION D.F. 2 the REVOLUTION D.F. X is also a compact, fully modular power dwarf with an overall depth of only 14 cm. The 80 PLUS® Gold certified power supply is included with our patented DFR™ (Dust Free Rotation) technology. This prevents dust accumulation on the fan blades and guarantees a clean and durable power supply. 

The decision to only use 100% Japanese 105°C first grade electrolytic capacitors guarantees high manufacturing quality and a long-lasting product. Based on an advanced Half Bridge LLC resonant converter and DC-to-DC circuit, the power supply is able to deliver perfect voltage regulation and very stable output power. The extremely stable single +12V rail, which can support up to twice of the maximum power output, allows high current peaks for high-performance processors and graphics cards without needing the system to be switched off immediatly. Sufficient protection is nevertheless guaranteed by OCP, OVP, UVP, OPP, SCP and OTP.

Title: Enermax Revolution D.F. X 1050 PSU Review - Tom's Hardware
URL: https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/power-supplies/enermax-revolution-d-f-x-1050-psu-review
Published: 2025-02-15T12:00:00.000Z
Author: Reviews By E. Fylladitakis
Highlights:
The Enermax Revolution D.F. X 1050 has a particularly interesting energy conversion efficiency curve. It is extremely efficient at low to medium loads, delivering figures that could easily grant it an 80Plus Platinum certification regardless of the input voltage. However, its efficiency drops significantly when the load is greater than 600 Watts, preventing the PSU from receiving an efficiency certification greater than 80Plus Gold. The average nominal load efficiency with an input voltage of 230 VAC is 92.7% a very high figure for an 80Plus Gold certified product. It drops significantly when the input voltage is reduced to 115 VAC, down to 90.2%, suggesting that the platform is largely optimized for a 230 VAC input, but it still easily meets the 80Plus Gold certification requirements.
